ip.providerSConfidenceAssessmentServiceU: The provider’s confidence in its assessment, not service uptime or the probability of accessing an AI platform.
ip.otherAssociatedNetworkAddressesNecess: Other associated network addresses, not necessarily on the same server or used by the same person.
